name: Al-Azhar Mosque
subtitle: Historic Fatimid congregational mosque founded in 970 CE, evolving into one of the oldest and most prestigious Islamic universities in the world.

facts.label: Status
facts.value: One of the oldest continually operating universities in the world

parts.text: The foundational mosque of Fatimid Cairo, begun in 970 CE by military commander Jawhar al-Siqilli under Caliph al-Mu'izz li-Din Allah. Beyond its status as a monumental five-minaret congregational place of worship, Al-Azhar developed into one of the world's oldest continuously operating institutions of higher learning and the principal intellectual center of Sunni Islamic jurisprudence.

gaps: Architectural remodeling layers across Mamluk and Ottoman periods should be compared against specialized Cairene epigraphic texts.
